Class ImageProxyView

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.engine.ImageProxyView
All Implemented Interfaces:
RefCounted
public final class ImageProxyView extends Object implements RefCounted
Image views contain additional metadata for pipeline operations on images. This class is a tuple of ImageProxy, SurfaceOrigin and Swizzle.
